_comment: sim-robust-pick-wrist-guard-cspace-fix-v1 -- fixes the PR254 regression where the GUARDED live_pose transfer PICK approach (transfer_pick_wrist_guard) sent cuMotion a MALFORMED goal. PR254 appended a 2-entry wrist joint_constraints list onto the cuMotion task-space POSE goal; cuMotion reads ANY joint_constraints in goal_constraints as a FULL c-space target built from exactly those entries (dropping the pose), so it called planToCSpaceTarget([[-0.675, 1]]) against a 6-DOF robot -> 'Invalid c-space position: Number of c-space coordinates [2] must equal [6]' (x7) -> 'cumotion::FatalException ... CUDA error: out of memory' -> component_container_mt died exit -6 -> launch SIGINT'd the hosts -> TRAJ_HOST_FAULT 'executor stopped' + MANIP_HOST_FAILED op=transfer (pickguard1, ~/datasets/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1/mission/pickguard1). The two rejected coordinates are exactly PR254's band midpoints: wrist_1 (-2.0+0.65)/2=-0.675, wrist_2 (0.0+2.0)/2=1.0. The fix sends a CLEAN pose goal (no joint_constraints) and enforces the clear wrist family AFTER planning. Merge this ONE HOST-config key into the mission runtime-config HOST block (read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py). Absent/false => byte-identical.
_transfer_pick_wrist_guard_note: true => the live_pose transfer PICK approach is guarded WITHOUT a malformed goal. The APPROACH cuMotion task-space pose goal now carries NO joint_constraints; after it plans, ros_adapter validates the planned trajectory's TERMINAL wrist config against the clear carry region (ur_wrist_1 <= carry_wrist1_cap 0.65, ur_wrist_2 >= carry_wrist2_min 0.0). If it lands on the ur_wrist_2-vs-ur_forearm self-colliding family (coldwin12: terminal wrist_2 < 0) it RE-PLANS the same clean pose goal -- cuMotion is stochastic, so a fresh seed can draw the clear wrist_2-positive family (coldwin11) -- bounded by POSE_GUARD_REPLAN_MAX and the existing PLAN_TOTAL_ATTEMPTS_CAP=10 GPU dispatch cap, and FAILS FAST by the named reason 'pose goal could not reach the clear carry wrist region (wrist_1<=0.65, wrist_2>=0.0) within N re-plans' when exhausted. The CONTACT straight-line seeded-KDL IK is unchanged (already a well-formed full 6-joint c-space target guarded by _guard_rejects). No new thresholds, no controller gain change, PR239's settle envelope untouched.
_scope: Scoped to the live_pose transfer PICK (RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose + operation=transfer), phases approach and contact only. The same malformed c-space encoding on the fm327/fm403 task-space LIFT fallback (carry_wrist1_cap/carry_wrist2_min when carry_lift_shape is unset) is fixed by the same code path. collect, the preplace/place/retreat place half, and every non-live_pose transfer are untouched. A run that already lands the clear family at the approach re-plans zero times (byte-identical outcome).
_requires: RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose active for the run, and the HOST block's existing clear-region bounds carry_wrist1_cap (0.65) and carry_wrist2_min (0.0). Register transfer_pick_wrist_guard in the run's --require preflight (config_preflight knows it as a HOST key).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Primary: the staged transfer-only run (start_staging=recorded_bay_park, start_at=transfer, stop_after=transfer) with this key merged into the HOST block. PASS = grep -c 'Invalid c-space position' host-stack.log == 0; the approach plans on the clear family (a 'POSE_WRIST_GUARD accept' line with terminal wrist_2 >= 0, and NO 'pose goal could not reach the clear carry wrist region' fail); the pick contact settles (no 'TRAJ_HOST_FAULT pose not bounded', no 'MOVE_RETRY phase=contact' storm); transfer reaches verify; NO component_container_mt death and NO TRAJ_HOST_FAULT 'executor stopped'. HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG shows transfer_pick_wrist_guard active. Then the full COLD capstone (collect -> couple -> outbound -> park -> transfer -> verify) re-run with this key on. GPU rules: one run at a time under flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, never forced, HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr (~2.2 GB), never touch whispr (pid 1339).
_also_verifies_step3: If a guarded host component (component_container_mt) ever dies again, launch.py now logs 'HOST_GUARD_EXIT host component ... exited (exit code -6): what(): CUDA error: out of memory' and the trajectory executor's last-resort fault reads that via RESTOCK_HOST_GUARD_MARKER and reports the NAMED cause instead of the bare 'executor stopped'. With this fix the malformed-target death should not recur, so this path should stay silent.
